kind.zoom.chip.description: Review mode: the short chip on a row whose change is of this kind: automatic zooms.

kind.zoom.name.description: Review mode: the name of this kind of change (automatic zooms) inside a row's spoken description, lower case: "Cut 2.4 s of silence, {kind}, at 0:12.4, …".

kind.zoom.all.description: Review mode: the footer button that removes every change of this kind still to review (automatic zooms).

kind.zoom.count.description: Review mode: a count of changes of this kind (automatic zooms) inside "Removed {things}." and "Removing {things}…"; {n} is the count as shown.

kind.colour.count.description: Review mode: a count of changes of this kind (automatic colour balance of the camera) inside "Removed {things}." and "Removing {things}…"; {n} is the count as shown.

kind.short.chip.description: Review mode: the short chip on a row whose change is of this kind: cuts made by Make a shorter version.

kind.short.name.description: Review mode: the name of this kind of change (cuts made by Make a shorter version) inside a row's spoken description, lower case: "Cut 2.4 s of silence, {kind}, at 0:12.4, …".

changes.description: Review mode: a count of automatic changes of any kind, inside "Kept {things}." and "Keeping {things}…"; {n} is the count as shown.

status.pending.description: Review mode: a row's status at the end of its spoken description and under an item of a group: not kept or removed yet. Lower case.

status.kept.description: Review mode: a row's status: the change was kept. Lower case.

status.removed.description: Review mode: a row's status: the change was removed. Lower case.

title.description: Review mode: the panel's title and the title bar button's tooltip. Lists every change Flown made by itself, to keep or remove.

empty.description: Review mode: shown in the panel when there is nothing to review.

hint.description: Review mode: the keys of the list, above it. N, P, K, Delete and the arrows are key names: keep them as they are.

place.topLeft.description: Review mode: where in the frame an automatic zoom aims, in thirds, inside a row title ("Zoom in on a click, {place}"). Lower case.

place.top.description: Review mode: where in the frame a zoom aims (the top middle third), inside a row title. Lower case.

place.topRight.description: Review mode: where in the frame a zoom aims, inside a row title. Lower case.

place.left.description: Review mode: where in the frame a zoom aims (the middle left third), inside a row title. Lower case.

place.middle.description: Review mode: where in the frame a zoom aims (the centre third), inside a row title. Lower case.

place.right.description: Review mode: where in the frame a zoom aims (the middle right third), inside a row title. Lower case.

place.bottomLeft.description: Review mode: where in the frame a zoom aims, inside a row title. Lower case.

place.bottom.description: Review mode: where in the frame a zoom aims (the bottom middle third), inside a row title. Lower case.

place.bottomRight.description: Review mode: where in the frame a zoom aims, inside a row title. Lower case.

zoom.pullBack.description: Review mode: the title of an automatic zoom that zooms out (shows more than the whole frame).

zoom.typing.description: Review mode: the title of an automatic zoom made where the user typed.

zoom.typingAt.description: Review mode: the title of an automatic zoom made where the user typed; {place} says where in the frame ("top right").

zoom.click.description: Review mode: the title of an automatic zoom made at a mouse click.

zoom.clickAt.description: Review mode: the title of an automatic zoom made at a mouse click; {place} says where in the frame ("top right").

zoom.in.description: Review mode: the title of an automatic zoom that follows the cursor.

zoom.inAt.description: Review mode: the title of an automatic zoom at a fixed place; {place} says where in the frame ("middle").

layout.corner.topLeft.description: Review mode: the title of an automatic change that moved the camera bubble to the top left corner of the video.

layout.corner.topRight.description: Review mode: the title of an automatic change that moved the camera bubble to the top right corner.

layout.corner.bottomLeft.description: Review mode: the title of an automatic change that moved the camera bubble to the bottom left corner.

layout.corner.bottomRight.description: Review mode: the title of an automatic change that moved the camera bubble to the bottom right corner.

layout.bubble.description: Review mode: the title of an automatic change back to the camera bubble (the small camera over the screen).

layout.cameraOnly.description: Review mode: the title of an automatic change to the camera filling the frame.

layout.cameraLarge.description: Review mode: the title of an automatic change to a large camera over the screen.

layout.sideBySide.description: Review mode: the title of an automatic change to the camera beside the screen.

layout.screenOnly.description: Review mode: the title of an automatic change that hides the camera.

framing.title.description: Review mode: the title of the automatic change that centres the camera on the speaker's face.

framing.detail.description: Review mode: the tool that made a camera change, shown after the time on its row (the Camera director feature).

cut.retake.description: Review mode: the title of a cut that removed a retake (a sentence said again); {said} is the words removed, as said.

cut.repeat.description: Review mode: the title of a cut that removed repeated words; {said} is the words removed.

cut.words.description: Review mode: the title of a cut that removed filler words; {said} is the words removed.

cut.short.description: Review mode: the title of a cut Make a shorter version made; {seconds} is how much was cut ("2.4 s").

cut.silence.description: Review mode: the title of a silence that was cut; {seconds} is its length ("2.4 s").

cut.idle.description: Review mode: the title of idle time (no typing or clicks) that was cut; {seconds} is its length.

sped.silence.description: Review mode: the title of a silence played faster; {seconds} is its length, {factor} how many times as fast ("Sped up 2.4 s of silence 4×").

sped.idle.description: Review mode: the title of idle time played faster; {seconds} is its length, {factor} how many times as fast.

cutBy.silences.description: Review mode: the tool that made a cut, after the time on its row: the Remove silences tool.

cutBy.polish.description: Review mode: the tool that made a cut: Polish in one click.

cutBy.smartSpeed.description: Review mode: the tool that made a cut or speed-up: Smart speed (idle time).

cutBy.filler.description: Review mode: what a word cut removed: filler words ("um", "uh").

cutBy.retake.description: Review mode: what a word cut removed: a retake (a sentence said again).

cutBy.repeat.description: Review mode: what a word cut removed: repeated words.

cutBy.short.description: Review mode: the tool that made a cut: Make a shorter version.

progress.description: Review mode: how many automatic changes have been kept or removed so far, of all of them.

row.name.description: Review mode: what a screen reader says for a row: its title, its kind, its time in the video, the tool that made it and its status ("Cut 2.4 s of silence, silence, at 0:12.4, Polish, not reviewed").

acted.keep.description: Review mode: said to screen readers after one change was kept.

acted.remove.description: Review mode: said to screen readers after one change was removed.

bulk.kept.description: Review mode: said after Keep all; {things} is a count of changes ("26 changes").

bulk.removed.description: Review mode: said after Remove all; {things} is a count of changes of one kind ("5 zooms").

busy.rule.description: Review mode: said as Keep all or Remove all starts on a long list: what waits for it and what stops it. Keep, Remove, Undo and Redo are the buttons and commands.

busy.keeping.description: Review mode: said as Keep all starts on a long list; {things} is a count ("8098 changes"), {rule} the sentence that says what waits.

busy.removing.description: Review mode: said as Remove all starts on a long list; {things} is a count ("5399 silence cuts"), {rule} the sentence that says what waits.

stillBusy.keeping.description: Review mode: said when Keep all is pressed while it still works; {things} is a count ("8098 changes").

stillBusy.removing.description: Review mode: said when Remove all is pressed while it still works; {things} is a count ("5399 silence cuts").

wait.keepDuringKeepAll.description: Review mode: said when a row's Keep is pressed while Keep all works.

wait.keepDuringRemoveAll.description: Review mode: said when a row's Keep is pressed while Remove all works.

wait.removeDuringKeepAll.description: Review mode: said when a row's Remove is pressed while Keep all works.

wait.removeDuringRemoveAll.description: Review mode: said when a row's Remove is pressed while Remove all works.

stale.alreadyKept.description: Review mode: said when a Keep that waited finds its change already kept meanwhile.

stale.alreadyRemoved.description: Review mode: said when a Remove that waited finds its change already removed meanwhile.

stale.notKept.description: Review mode: said when a Keep that waited finds its change removed meanwhile.

stale.notRemoved.description: Review mode: said when a Remove that waited finds its change kept meanwhile.

stopped.keepAll.description: The editor's notice when closing Review mode stopped Keep all before it was done.

stopped.removeAll.description: The editor's notice when closing Review mode stopped Remove all before it was done; {action} is the button's name ("Remove all silence cuts", "Remove all").

busyWord.keep.description: Review mode: the Keep all button while it works.

busyWord.remove.description: Review mode: the Remove all button while it works.

button.pending.description: The title bar's Review button, for screen readers: opens Review mode; {n} is how many automatic changes are still to review.

button.none.description: The title bar's Review button, for screen readers, when every automatic change was reviewed.

button.label.description: The title bar's Review button: opens Review mode (a verb: check the automatic changes).

panel.close.description: Review mode: the panel's close button (tooltip and name).

panel.reviewed.description: Review mode: the name of the progress bar of changes reviewed.

panel.keepAll.description: Review mode: the footer button that keeps every change still to review.

panel.list.description: Review mode: the list's name for screen readers.

row.keep.description: Review mode: a row's Keep button for screen readers; {title} is the row's title.

row.remove.description: Review mode: a row's Remove button for screen readers; {title} is the row's title.

row.hideParts.description: Review mode: the button that hides a group row's items (Captions Studio's emphasis and text fixes); {title} is the row's title.

row.showParts.description: Review mode: the button that shows a group row's items; {title} is the row's title.

mark.kept.description: Review mode: shown with a tick where Keep and Remove were, once the change was kept.

mark.removed.description: Review mode: shown where Keep and Remove were, once the change was removed.
